# StateFlow Games

> StateFlow Games is an independent game development studio creating high-quality, engaging mobile games for Android and web platforms, specializing in construction tycoon simulators, strategic management games, and educational puzzle adventures.

## Studio Overview
- **Studio Name**: StateFlow Games
- **Developer / Publisher**: Muratium Labs
- **Official Website**: https://muratiumlabs.github.io/stateflow-games/
- **Support & Inquiries**: muratiumlabs@gmail.com / stateflowgames@gmail.com
- **Platforms**: Google Play Store (Android), Web

## Flagship Game: Construction Tycoon Empire
- **Full Title**: Construction Tycoon Empire
- **Genre**: Construction Tycoon / Idle Business Simulator / City Building & Management
- **Target Platform**: Android (Google Play Store)
- **Package Name**: `com.stateflowgames.constructiontycoonempire`
- **Core Gameplay**:
  - Build and manage realistic, soaring architectural towers, luxury residential villas, and commercial skyscrapers.
  - Unlock and upgrade heavy construction equipment: Liebherr tower cranes, CAT excavators, concrete mixers, and specialized transport.
  - Dynamic day/night cycle with unique atmospheric economic boosts, including the "Golden Hour Sunset" (+10% floor valuation bonus).
  - Offline passive income generation, manager automation, worker contracts, and material supply chain management.
  - Prestigious milestone tiers from cozy suburbs to futuristic mega-towers.
- **Privacy & Safety**: Safe for all ages, GDPR & COPPA compliant, no intrusive personal data collection.

## Other Games by StateFlow Games
- **Matematik Kantini**: Fast-paced educational math puzzle game for kids and brain-training enthusiasts, designed with school cafeteria mechanics and mental math challenges.
- **NeuroPlex**: Minimalist spatial logic and brain puzzle training game.
- **Drag Code**: Visual block programming puzzle game teaching algorithms and sequential logic through interactive mechanics.
